paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络难以训练的问题，提出了残差学习框架，让堆叠层学习相对于输入的残差映射而非无参照映射 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上验证了极深残差网络易于优化，并能从深度增加中获得精度提升，而对应的普通网络随深度增加训练误差反而升高 [S1.p7]。152 层残差网络是当时 ImageNet 上最深网络，复杂度仍低于 VGG，集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 错误率并赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S1.p9]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层网络 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练精度反而下降（退化问题），而这不是由梯度消失/爆炸造成的 [S1.p4]。作者指出，按构造存在一个更深的模型其训练误差不应高于较浅对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到与构造解相当或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.
The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不要求每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，而是让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原映射改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参照映射更容易 [S1.p5]。捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，因此可以在参数、深度、宽度和计算开销相同的条件下公平比较普通网络与残差网络 [S3.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
We hypothesize that it is easier to optimize the residual mapping than to optimize the original, unreferenced mapping.
The shortcut connections in Eqn.( 1) introduce neither extra parameter nor computation complexity.
We can fairly compare plain/residual networks that simultaneously have the same number of parameters, depth, width, and computational cost

experiments.text: 作者在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。训练采用随机尺度增强、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用 BN，SGD 小批量 256，学习率从 0.1 开始，误差平台时除以 10，最多训练 60×10^4 次迭代，权重衰减 0.0001，动量 0.9，不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上研究极深网络行为，使用简单架构、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、BN、无 dropout，小批量 128，学习率 0.1 并在 32k 和 48k 迭代时除以 10，64k 迭代终止 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p3]。还在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上以 Faster R-CNN 做目标检测，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation
We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256.
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
These models are trained with a mini-batch size of 128 on two GPUs.
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差明显更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题在此设置下得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，优于此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]；1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差 7.93%，但测试结果差于 110 层网络，作者认为原因是过拟合 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。在目标检测上，ResNet-101 在 COCO 标准指标 mAP@[.5,.95] 上比 VGG-16 提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
This indicates that the degradation problem is well addressed in this setting
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1%
Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error. We argue that this is because of overfitting.
we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement

limitations.text: 作者承认，1202 层网络测试结果差于 110 层网络，认为原因是过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大，本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者还指出，深层普通网络优化困难的原因尚不清楚，将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。此外，多尺度训练因时间有限未进行，多尺度测试也仅用于 Fast R-CNN 步骤而未用于 RPN 步骤 [A2.p5]。

evidence.quote: The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
we have not performed multi-scale training because of limited time
we have performed multi-scale testing only for the Fast R-CNN step (but not yet for the RPN step)
